purpose: Define reload as an explicit runtime lifecycle operation that re-resolves the intended accepted snapshot/configuration without treating filesystem changes as automatically active.

topics.name: Runtime Reload
topics.purpose: Define reload as an explicit runtime lifecycle operation that re-resolves the intended accepted snapshot/configuration without treating filesystem changes as automatically active.

semantics.reload_rule: Reload is explicit; repository/file changes alone do not mutate live runtime semantics.
semantics.target_rule: Reload target is the configured/current accepted snapshot or an explicitly named accepted snapshot according to operation semantics.
semantics.config_rule: Applicable instance configuration is re-read through its canonical owner/binding.
semantics.dependency_rule: Dependencies are revalidated; missing required dependencies hard-fail.
semantics.atomic_rule: Reload commits a coherent new runtime state or preserves prior coherent state.
semantics.ac_rule: `reload ac` activates/reloads AccessCore according to AC lifecycle contract; it is not a generic authorization bypass.
semantics.trace_rule: Reload records old/new active snapshot/config refs and result.

invariants.rule: Repository acceptance establishes canonical source state; runtime activation/reload is a separate explicit lifecycle operation over an exact accepted snapshot.

hard_gates.condition: filesystem write automatically changes live runtime
reload reads candidate source as active

references.purpose: Reload follows the same coherent activation boundary.
